extracted.intended_audience: research administrators and grant applicants preparing/submitting NIH (and other participating agencies') applications using ASSIST
extracted.subtask_short: preparing NIH grant applications in ASSIST
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting SF424 Research & Related electronic grant applications using the ASSIST web-based system, covering access, collaborative preparation, application composition (single- and multi-project), validations, and output/preview expectations. Intended to help applicants and institutional staff assemble compliant application packages for Grants.gov/NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access via eRA Commons credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage current eRA Commons credentials to access ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must use their established eRA Commons account to log in and access ASSIST functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegate application preparation with access control
rubrics_metrics.description: Delegate application preparation responsibilities to multiple users within and outside the applicant organization while maintaining appropriate access control and security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST supports multi-user collaboration but requires appropriate role/permission management so that tasks can be shared without compromising security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Populate data from eRA Commons profiles
rubrics_metrics.description: Populate data from established eRA Commons profiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use existing profile data to autofill forms and reduce manual entry; ensure profiles are current and accurate before populating application fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run validations on federal-wide and agency business rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Run validations on federal-wide and agency business rules prior to submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Execute built-in validation checks in ASSIST to detect errors and rule violations before submitting through Grants.gov; these validations reflect both federal-wide and agency-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic generation of Table of Contents, headers, footers, page numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate Table of Contents, headers, footers, page numbers, etc. automatically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST will create consistent document structure elements automatically to match the agency's expected application format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Preview in agency submission format
rubrics_metrics.description: Print/Preview applications prior to submission in the format used by the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before submitting, use ASSIST's print/preview feature to confirm the application appears exactly as the agency will receive it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide clear, color PDF images (not scanned)
rubrics_metrics.description: Present to reviewers clear, color PDF images rather than scanned versions of the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST produces native PDFs to improve reviewer readability and avoid issues associated with scanned documents (e.g., poor quality or legibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate need to prepare and ship multiple paper copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid the hassle of preparing and shipping multiple paper copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronic submission via ASSIST/Grants.gov is intended to remove the requirement for physical paper submissions where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for single-project application content
rubrics_metrics.description: All electronic single-project applications prepared in ASSIST will include all required forms necessary for the application package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST also includes all optional forms available for the application package; ensure you include required attachments and complete required form fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for multi-project application structure
rubrics_metrics.description: All electronic multi-project applications prepared in ASSIST will include a single Overall Component that describes the entire application and how each of the additional components fit together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Overall Component should explain the relationship among components and provide a high-level summary of the multi-component application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component-level requirements for multi-project applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Components: Some number of other component types (e.g., Admin Core, Project, Core) with predefined data collection requirements set by the agency when posting the opportunity in Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each component type has specific, agency-defined data collection fields and requirements; follow those predefined templates when populating component content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summaries and roll-ups for multi-project applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Summaries: Information compiled from the data provided in the individual components (e.g., component and categorical roll-ups of budget data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST will compile summary information across components—such as aggregated budgets—so ensure component entries are complete and accurate to produce correct roll-ups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use SF424 Research & Related form set and submit through Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: The ASSIST system is used to prepare applications using the SF424 Research & Related form set and to submit electronically through Grants.gov to NIH and other participating agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare your application using the SF424 R&R forms in ASSIST and complete the Grants.gov submission workflow; confirm the opportunity number to determine application type and required forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browser compatibility caution (Internet Explorer Compatibility Mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: Some screens may not display correctly in the Internet Explorer browser with Compatibility Mode turned on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To ensure screens display correctly, turn off Compatibility Mode or use a different browser.
